notes: All captures come from one session at DPR 3 (Release WebAssembly); Light comes from the app's own theme switch, since TRACE ignores the browser scheme.
Text inside full-window device frames is below 10 px at 1x, as in the house-style references; it reads at 2x and in the hero.
Relative times ("3 min ago") agree between the Light and Dark Findings captures only to the minute.
stylized-fleet repeats the pump of focus-pump; C-07's fourth point sits behind the pump's card.
